{{Top|leg}}
The '''energy collector''' [[droid shield]]s were initially designed to resist the harsh conditions of factory floors. These shields provided a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] with basic protection against a wide array of effects. However, the power drain was significant and the shields would have been replaced regularly.

==Behind the scenes==
A droid must be at upgrade class 1 to be able to equip this item.
